比肩.title: A day your true colors shine
lines: Today your "born {B}" side is at its strongest. Go at your own pace instead of matching others.
Today your "I just feel it's this way" beats other people's opinions.
No need to put on an act today. People find the real you the easiest to talk to.
比肩.tip: If it's yours to decide, decide it yourself

劫財.title: A day your competitive side shows
lines: You might feel like competing today. Use that drive to beat your own record, not someone else.
If comparing yourself to someone stings, that's your born fighting spirit. It's not a bad thing.
Today you may not want to give an inch. Hold firm only on what matters, and let the rest go with a smile.
劫財.tip: When you want to compare, compare with yesterday's you

食神.title: The more you enjoy, the luckier you get
lines: Today it's okay to relax. Eat something delicious and your born self will perk up.
Today, having fun works better than trying hard. Add one little treat to your plans.
Today, just being there puts everyone at ease. Reach out to someone you get along with.
食神.tip: Just for today, have the treat first

傷官.title: A day your senses are sharp
lines: Your intuition is sharp today. But so are your words. Take a breath before you speak.
Today you'll easily notice when something feels off. You're probably right. Just say it gently.
Your sense of style shines today. In clothes or in writing, the care you put in will come through.
傷官.tip: Read it over once before you hit send

偏財.title: A day your circle grows
lines: Today "you now" gets to shine. If someone invites you, just go with it.
Detours pay off today. Try a different road or a different shop.
Spending time with people is fun today. Send a quick note to someone you haven't talked to in a while.
偏財.tip: When invited, start by saying "Sounds good"

正財.title: A day steady effort pays off
lines: Today "you now" gets rewarded for being diligent. The plainer the task, the more it pays off later.
A good day to get your money and time in order. Take a quick look at your receipts or schedule.
Today people trust you for keeping your word. The smaller the promise, the more it matters.
正財.tip: Take care of one small errand you've been putting off

偏官.title: A day you handle surprises well
lines: Today might get hectic. But "you now" is at your best on days like this.
A sudden request may come your way. You don't have to take it all on. Just the one that matters most.
Your drive is up today. If you've been on the fence about something, take just one step forward.
偏官.tip: When in doubt, give it just 5 minutes

正官.title: A day your diligence gets noticed
lines: Today, the skills "you now" worked hard for get the recognition they deserve.
The more you follow the rules and the plan, the better today goes. Move 5 minutes earlier than usual.
Someone will rely on you today. Once you've come through for them, give yourself some praise on the way home.

偏印.title: A day ideas come to you
lines: Today your born flashes of inspiration are sharp. Jot down whatever comes to mind.
Time alone recharges you most today. Don't pack your schedule too tight.
Today you'll think differently from others. It's probably interesting, so share it with someone later.
偏印.tip: Save your ideas in your phone's notes

印綬.title: A day of learning and helping hands
lines: Today people will help "you now." Don't carry it all alone; it's okay to lean on others.
New things sink in easily today. That book or video you've been curious about? Today's the day.
Today there's a hint in what a mentor or family member says. Try asking them.
印綬.tip: Ask someone about one thing you don't understand

high.label: Power: high
high.add: Your energy is full. Do what you want to do today, today.

mid.label: Power: medium
mid.add: Your energy is moderate. Your usual pace is just right today.

low.label: Power: low
low.add: Your energy is in power-saving mode. Going to bed early is today's best luck boost.
